description: This Java class implements a command strategy for updating a datatable entry in a one-to-many relationship within the Apache Fineract project. It processes REST API requests, extracts path parameters, invokes the API resource to perform the update, and constructs the batch response.

classes.name: UpdateDatatableEntryOneToManyCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing CommandStrategy to handle updating datatable entries associated with entities via API requests in a batch process.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a BatchRequest to update a datatable entry, extracting parameters from the URL, invoking the DatatablesApiResource, and constructing a BatchResponse with the outcome.
